use_case_summary: Primary: in-product assistant that executes multistep user flows (search -> propose -> action)
Agent flows include external tool calls: CRM write, ticket creation, search index update, calendar booking
Need streaming responses to show progressive plan + allow user cancel/confirm
High sensitivity to agent tool-call reliability and end-to-end idempotency
Latency SLO target: first-decision p50 <= 200ms, end-to-end action confirmation p95 <= 800ms under nominal load
Throughput target: peak 50 rps agent flows during business hours; steady-state 10-15 rps
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; leaning toward Dedicated if unit cost < Hosted baseline by >=20% for sustained volume
poc_plan: Week 0: onboarding - API keys, sample agent harness, connect search index (Elastic) and test CRM sandbox
Week 1: run synthetic scenarios (50 rps), collect metrics: token latency (first-byte), tool-call duration, tool-call success rate
Week 2: run user-simulated sessions with live product team; measure end-to-end action time and failure modes; test retries/backoff
Success criteria: tool-call success >= 99.5% under POC load; end-to-end p95 <= 800ms for confirmed actions; streaming first-byte p50 <= 200ms
Deliverables: telemetry dashboard, failure-mode report, cost projection for Hosted vs Dedicated
technical_questions: How does Redwood guarantee ordering and at-most-once semantics for function/tool-calls?
Is there an SDK pattern for idempotent tool-call tokens / dedup keys?
What are the recommended timeouts and retry policies for synchronous vs async tool calls?
Can streaming be combined with long-running async tool calls and callback webhooks?
Expected p95 token latency and variability across regions; cold-start behavior for model variants
Options for prefix/KV cache to reduce repeated context assembly costs
pricing_discussion: AE provided preliminary Hosted API cost estimate plus Dedicated ballpark. Customer wants a committed Dedicated tier if POC shows >=20% cost savings with SLOs met. Asks for a 12-month reserved option with monthly true-up and clear overage pricing. Also requested an example TCO comparing: (a) Hosted API with streaming + retries, (b) Dedicated with 2x A100 equiv capacity and autoscale buffers.
